value.summary: The City of Medicine Hat is seeking proposals from qualified vendors to provide a modern, user-friendly, and secure Corporate Learning Management System (LMS) to support corporate training, onboarding, compliance, safety, professional development, and certification tracking for employees, volunteers, and other external learners.
